white-collar worker.englishDescription: A person who usually works at a company, etc., and receives a regular paycheck.

whitening.definitionKo: 피부나 치아 등을 인공적인 방법으로 희게 함.
whitening.englishDescription: The act of making skin or teeth white by using artificial means.

widely spread.definitionKo: 여러 사람의 입에 오르내려 널리 퍼져 있다.
widely spread.englishDescription: Being spread abroad by being talked about by many people.

wilt.definitionKo: 꽃이나 풀 같은 식물이 물기가 말라 원래의 색이나 모양을 잃다.
wilt.englishDescription: For a plant such as a flower, grass, etc., to dry out and lose its original color or appearance.

winning.englishDescription: An act of earning and possessing something.

winning a prize.englishDescription: The state of having been chosen in a screening or selection.

winning a prize.definitionKo: 대회나 전시회에 낸 작품이 심사에 합격하여 뽑힘.
winning a prize.englishDescription: A state in which one's work is submitted, evaluated and then selected for a competition or an exhibition.
winning a prize.englishExpression: being selected; being accepted; winning a prize

with.definitionKo: 앞말이 어떤 행위나 감정 등의 대상임을 나타내는 조사.
with.englishDescription: A postpositional particle to indicate that the preceding statement is the subject that is influenced by a certain action, emotion, etc.

with.definitionKo: 앞말이 어떤 일의 도구나 수단, 방법 등임을 나타내는 조사.
with.englishDescription: A postpositional particle to indicate that the preceding statement is the tools, means, methods, etc., of something.
A postpositional particle to indicate that the preceding statement is the subject of comparison.

with a shrug.definitionKo: 어깨를 한 번 올렸다 내리는 모양.
with a shrug.englishDescription: A word describing one raising and lowering one's shoulders once.

with a shrug.definitionKo: 어깨를 자꾸 올렸다 내렸다 하는 모양.
with a shrug.englishDescription: A word describing one repeatedly raising and lowering one's shoulders.

with enthusiasm.englishDescription: With all one's heart, with great care and enthusiasm.

with laughter.englishDescription: A word imitating a sudden, short burst of laughter.

within the same day.englishExpression: that day; within the same day

without any doubt.definitionKo: 더 어찌할 필요가 없이. 또는 달리 어찌할 방법이나 가능성이 없이.
without any doubt.englishDescription: Without further need to do anything else; or without any other way or possibility of doing anything else.

woolen gloves.englishDescription: A pair of gloves knitted with wool.

words and actions.englishDescription: A collective term for words and actions.

words go up and down.englishDescription: For a story to become a topic.

world view.definitionKo: 세계와 그 세계를 이루고 있는 인간 및 인생의 의의와 가치에 대한 생각.
world view.englishDescription: The way someone thinks about the world, and the significance and values of the people and lives that make up the world.

yellow animal.definitionKo: (귀엽게 이르는 말로) 털의 색깔이 노란 동물.

yellowish here and there.definitionKo: 고르지 않게 조금 탁하고 칙칙하면서도 밝게 노랗다.

yellowish here and there.englishDescription: Unevenly tinted with slightly impure and light yellow.

yesterday and today are different.definitionKo: 하루 사이에 차이가 생겨서 어제 같지 않다.
yesterday and today are different.englishDescription: For something today to be not like what it was yesterday because there has been a change overnight.

annotations: 이황의 성과 호를 함께 이르는 말이다.
yi toegye.definitionKo: 조선 시대의 학자(1501~1570). 안동에 도산 서원을 세워 많은 제자를 가르쳤다. 이이와 함께 한국 최고의 성리학자로 꼽힌다.
yi toegye.englishDescription: A pen name for Yi Hwang (1501-1570), a scholar of the Joseon Dynasty; as a founder of Dosan Seowon, a Korean Confucian academy, in Andong, he taught many disciples; along with Yi I, he is regarded as one of the most prominent Neo-Confucian scholars in Korea.

yijo.definitionKo: 이 씨가 세운 조선이라는 뜻으로, ‘조선’을 낮추어 이르는 말.
yijo.englishDescription: Yi Dynasty: The Joseon Dynasty established by the Yi clan, a word used to address "Joseon" in a humble manner.

yips.definitionKo: 강아지 등이 놀라거나 아파서 자꾸 짖는 소리.
yips.englishDescription: A word imitating the yelping sound a dog makes out of fear or pain.

yips.definitionKo: 개가 무섭거나 아파서 자꾸 지르는 소리.
yips.englishDescription: A word imitating the yelping sound a dog makes repeatedly out of fear or pain.

you know.definitionKo: 사실을 말할 때, 상대의 생각을 가볍게 반박하거나 새롭게 일깨워 주는 뜻으로 하는 말.
you know.englishDescription: An exclamation used to refute the other party's opinion lightly or to inform him/her of a new piece of information.

you know.definitionKo: 사실을 말할 때, 상대의 생각을 가볍게 반박하거나 새롭게 일깨워 주는 뜻으로 하는 말.
you know.englishDescription: An exclamation used to refute the other party's opinion lightly or to inform him/her of a new piece of information.
